featured_reviews.name: hemangi thorat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional and intrusive behavior by staff - Pooja

I visited this medical store to purchase medicines for my father. While I was already being attended by another staff member at the counter, a lady staff member named Pooja, who was not assisting any customer, repeatedly stared at me and then leaned in to ask, “Aap chehre ke liye kuch karti nahi kya?” in an interrogative tone.

This comment was completely unsolicited, inappropriate, and irrelevant to the purpose of my visit. Despite my clear discomfort and refusal, she proceeded to push a random cosmetic product, insisted that I try it, and even suggested taking photos and “thinking about it later.”

This is a medical store, not a beauty consultation center. Making personal remarks about a customer’s appearance and aggressively pushing products—especially without consent—is highly unprofessional and emotionally distressing.

The management must address this immediately and ensure proper training on professional boundaries and respectful customer interaction. Such conduct has no place in a medical store. Customers should be aware that they may be subjected to unsolicited personal remarks and pressure to buy irrelevant products. This behavior should not be tolerated.
